test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a biometric-enabled digital service for pensioners launched by the Government of India?

options.text: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Beema Yojna

solution:
The correct answer is __**Jeevan Pramaan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jeevan Pramaan is a biometric-enabled digital service for pensioners launched by the Government of India.**
 
• The Jeevan Pramaan scheme provides the benefit of pension to employees of Central Government, State Government or other Government organizations by providing them with a digital certificate as pension proof.
 
• The total number of pensioners exceeds 50 lakhs and also includes Army and Defense personnel.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• According to the Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojna, there are three categories__ of schemes/ loans which are as follows:

 
 
• Shishu- Loan of up to Rs. 50,000
 
• Kishore- Rs. 50,000 to 5.0 Lakhs
 
• Tarun- Rs 5.0 Lakhs to 10.0 Lakhs 
 
• ​MUDRA stands for Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency Ltd., is a financial institution set up by the Government of India for the development and refinancing of micro units enterprises. 
 
 
 
• Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana( PMJDY)
 
 
• It was launched on 28 August 2014 from New Delhi.
 
• ​It is the National Mission for Financial Inclusion launched by the Government Of India.
 
• It is started with the aim to provide universal banking services to every unbanked adult.
 
• There is no minimum limit to maintaining an account balance(commonly known as a zero balance account) opened under PMJDY.
 
• The Ministry of Finance is the nodal ministry for PMJDY.
